subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful `after_compaction` plugin hooks permanently receive a public, current-session-scoped `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` capability across OpenClaw, Codex, and Copilot harness paths?
rationale: This is an additive public plugin API and lifecycle contract; code review can validate mechanics but cannot decide whether OpenClaw should support and maintain this capability or which harnesses form its permanent compatibility surface.

options.title: Approve the narrow API
options.body: Accept the current-session-only deferred contract after the two code blockers, direct Codex contract check, and exact-head lifecycle proof are completed.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Retain reset queuing as an internal compaction recovery seam without exposing `resetSession` through the public plugin hook context.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or redesign the PR until a broader session-lifecycle API proposal establishes permissions, supported hook phases, harness behavior, and failure semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API
recommendation.body: Accept the current-session-only deferred contract after the two code blockers, direct Codex contract check, and exact-head lifecycle proof are completed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns repository-wide plugin API and session lifecycle policy rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
